title: Sandbox and roll back adapter upgrades
goal: Install an adapter revision beside the active one, run contract checks, and switch only after success; a failed upgrade preserves the working revision and in-flight session ownership. Deps (vectors): VC-201-061, VC-201-063, VC-201-076, VC-201-086. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_089_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
